about:
Laurel Furniture & Mattresses operates as a home goods retailer in Laurel, Maryland. The business opened in 2018 and serves the local community from a storefront at 13489 Baltimore Avenue, ZIP 20707. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The company sells furniture, mattresses, and home accessories through its physical store. No manufacturing or fabrication processes are performed on site; inventory is sourced from external suppliers. The retail space operates Monday through Saturday from 10:00 a.m. to 7:30 p.m. and Sunday from 10:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. Facility size, headcount, and sales volumes have not been published.

The retailer targets residential consumers seeking affordable home furnishings. Walk-in customers and local shoppers make up the primary customer base; no industrial or commercial accounts are mentioned. The business advertises a wide selection of merchandise to suit various tastes and budgets.

The company emphasizes affordable pricing and a broad selection as its main appeal. No further differentiation or founding mission is described in available sources. The company maintains a website built on the Wix platform for basic information and contact.
